_howto: The game's WHAT'S NEW: the title screen's message of the day (motd) and the changelog, newest first. Player-facing only.
motd: Version 9.0.0: Origin! The mountain guide at FAIRHAVEN leads you up to the last region.

changelog.title: Origin
changes: The ninth and last region, ORIGIN: after the TEMPESTA LEAGUE, the mountain guide at FAIRHAVEN leads you to ORIGIN GATE
Eight halls up the mountain, each kept by a CHAMPION you've beaten before, at full strength. Each counts as a badge
The Elite Four are the villains you beat along the way, each with the legend they chased. The CHAMPION is KAI, at level 900
ARCEUS waits in the HALL OF ORIGIN for whoever holds all 18 plates, and the altar there changes its type
VELLORIN, CALDERRA and the SUNDERED ISLES now have plate shrines in their first towns: two plates each
Two more plates on the mountain: the PIXIE PLATE and the BLANK PLATE
The level cap rises to 900; earlier regions stay as they were

changelog.title: Tempesta
changes: An eighth region, TEMPESTA: after the HOLLOW LEAGUE, the balloonist at GLOAMING flies you to FAIRHAVEN, the festival city
TEAM SOLSTICE has caged ARTICUNO, ZAPDOS and MOLTRES on three peaks to keep TEMPESTA in an endless spring
Free a bird and its season comes back. FAIRHAVEN's SEASON KEEPER turns the year: the weather, battles and wild POKéMON change with it
DELIBIRD's post office sends a parcel every season
Eight gyms, then the Elite Four and Champion ZEPHYRA at level 800. Rival KITE waits on the FESTIVAL ROAD
After the League, LUGIA rises at WHIRL ISLE, and the festival mirror shows the birds' Galarian forms
Tempesta trainers count the weather when they plan their moves
Two hidden plates: the FIST PLATE and the INSECT PLATE
The level cap rises to 800; earlier regions stay as they were

changelog.title: The Hollow Lands
changes: A seventh region, the HOLLOW LANDS: after the AETERNA LEAGUE, the ferryman at AETERNA VILLAGE rows you across to GLOAMING
A ring of faded towns around the CENOTAPH. The northern half of the ring takes four Hollow badges
Every road has a reverse side: step on a shadow to walk it mirrored, colourless, with its own wild POKéMON
Eight gyms, then the Elite Four and Champion ELEGY at level 700
TEAM HOLLOW and DR. LORNE, rival LUMEN, the PYRE TOWER, and GIRATINA in the DISTORTION WORLD past the reverse roads
An altar in the DISTORTION WORLD switches GIRATINA to its Origin form
Hollow trainers also weigh how hard your POKéMON can hit them back
Two hidden plates: the SPOOKY PLATE and the TOXIC PLATE
The level cap rises to 700; earlier regions stay as they were

changelog.title: Aeterna
changes: A sixth region, AETERNA: after the GENOVA LEAGUE, the conductor at GENOVA CENTRAL takes you out to AETERNA VILLAGE
One valley in two eras: step through a rift to walk the same valley long ago, with its own towns, trainers and wild POKéMON
Eight gyms, four now and four then, then the Elite Four and Champion AEON at level 600
TEAM PARADOX, rival TESS, DIALGA on the TEMPORAL SPIRE and PALKIA in the SPATIAL TEMPLE that stood there before it
Altars switch DIALGA and PALKIA to their Origin forms
Iron POKéMON in the present, ancient ones in the past
Aeterna trainers go for the knockout when you'd outspeed them
Two hidden plates: the DRACO PLATE, and the MIND PLATE (plant a seed in the past...)
The region map shows the era you're in
Fixed: rival NOVA now waits on GENOVA's CANOPY WALK
The level cap rises to 600; earlier regions stay as they were

changelog.title: Genova
changes: A fifth region, GENOVA: after the SKYREACH LEAGUE, the shuttle pilot at WINDWARD flies you to GENOVA CENTRAL
A walled city of labs and towers, with the old town and the jungle outside its walls. Going past the walls takes 4 GENOVA badges
Eight gyms, then the Elite Four and Champion CASSIA at level 500, at the top of the ARCOLOGY SPIRE
The SYNTHESIS CORP., rival NOVA, and the legends MEWTWO (SEALED CAVE) and MEW (LOST PIER)
MEW only trusts you once you have spotted it 10 times around the region
The first new POKéMON made for this game: CHIMURR, VOLTADPOLE, GRAFTLING and their evolutions, SPECTERRA, MIMICORE and HELIXEON
Genova trainers work out which move hits hardest
Two hidden plates: the IRON PLATE and the ZAP PLATE
Story bosses no longer call themselves your rival
The level cap rises to 500; earlier regions stay as they were

changelog.title: The Skyreach
changes: A fourth region, the SKYREACH: after the SUNDERED LEAGUE, the airship pilot at PORT KEEL flies you to WINDWARD
Three altitude bands: canyon floor, mesa tops and cloud level. Updrafts lift you higher at 3 and 6 SKYREACH badges
Eight gyms, each mixing two types, then the Elite Four and Champion ALTAIR at level 400
Team ZENITH, rival SORA, and the legends RAYQUAZA (SKY PILLAR) and DEOXYS (METEOR CRATER)
Meteorite shards change DEOXYS' form: Normal, Attack, Defense and Speed
Skyreach forms of GEODUDE, PONYTA, SWABLU and RHYHORN and their evolutions
Wind currents on the routes push you along, and strong winds in battle shield FLYING POKéMON from their weaknesses
Skyreach trainers spot your threats and go after them first
Two hidden plates: the SKY PLATE and the STONE PLATE
The level cap rises to 400; earlier regions stay as they were

changelog.title: Room for nine regions
changes: The game is about a third of its old size (5.6 MB, down from 17.4 MB), leaving room for all nine regions
POKéMON sprites are stored compressed
More room for new maps' tilesets in future regions
Levels of 100 and up no longer run into the HP bar on the party screen
MAGMA ISLE looks like a volcano now: scorched ground and charred trees

changelog.title: Sundered Isles fixes
changes: Long form names like SANDSLASH-SUNDER no longer turn into a jumble in battle
The HALL OF FAME line fits on screen for the SUNDERED ISLES
MT. KEEL's sealed path and a GROUDON or KYOGRE that gets away now say the right thing for the SUNDERED ISLES

changelog.title: The Sundered Isles
changes: THE SUNDERED ISLES, a third region themed on GROUDON and KYOGRE: after you become CALDERRA's CHAMPION, the CAPTAIN in PORT CALDER sails you to PORT KEEL
Eight gym islands around PORT KEEL, linked by sea routes, open in any order: GRASS, BUG, STEEL, FAIRY, GHOST, POISON, FIGHTING and PSYCHIC gyms
TEAM QUAKE wants GROUDON to fuse the islands into one land; TEAM NEPTUNE wants KYOGRE to drown the world. Stop both at MAGMA ISLE and THE ABYSS
Twelve SUNDERED FORMS: island forms of SANDSHREW, NUMEL, WAILMER, CORPHISH, CARVANHA, SABLEYE, TORKOAL and their evolutions, with new types
A new rival MARLO, KAI as your ally, and a new ELITE FOUR and CHAMPION at MT. KEEL
The level cap in the SUNDERED ISLES is 300. Bosses heal twice, and the best trainers carry held items and pick moves around yours
In the SUNDERED ISLES, rain on the stormy routes and harsh sun near MAGMA ISLE carry into battle
The region map is a pirate's treasure map, and somewhere out there is DOUBLOON SHOAL...

changelog.title: Lands of Nine
changes: The game has a new name: POKé LEGENDS: LANDS OF NINE
A new title screen: RAIKOU, ENTEI and SUICUNE on the ridge at dusk, HO-OH overhead and nine twinkling stars
A statue of WREN and VELLORIN's GYM LEADERS now stands in PORT CALDER
Becoming CALDERRA's CHAMPION puts your team in the HALL OF FAME
RAIKOU, ENTEI and SUICUNE keep the damage you did when they run
Your rival KAI battles you at PORT CALDER and at the top of each branch before the CRATER RIM

changelog.title: The Calderra region
changes: Every POKéMON up to Gen 9 joins the game
CALDERRA, a second region themed on RAIKOU, ENTEI and SUICUNE: take the ferry from PORTMERE in Adventure Mode
Three branches from PORT CALDER, open in any order: STORMREACH, the MISTRAL LAKES and CINDERDEEP, with eight new gyms
TEAM ECLIPSE, your new rival KAI, HO-OH at the ASHEN TOWER, and a new ELITE FOUR and CHAMPION
The level cap in CALDERRA is 200, and its trainers battle smarter and carry a FULL RESTORE
PROF. EMBER at PORT CALDER gives you a Gen 8 or 9 starter
RAIKOU, ENTEI and SUICUNE roam the region after you meet them
A MOVE TUTOR sells new moves, the POKéDEX counts each region, and a full national POKéDEX doubles your shiny odds
After the CALDERRA LEAGUE, its leaders rematch at level 200 and the CHALLENGE TOWER climbs to 200
The REGION MAP shows the region you are in and fast-travels within it
Saves from 1.9 carry over

changelog.title: Battle BAG tips
changes: The tip beside the BAG in battle fits its box again: it no longer cuts off "Out of POKé BALLS" or makes you press A before the list

changelog.title: Held items
changes: Your POKéMON can hold items now. Use ITEM > GIVE or TAKE on the party screen, or pick a held item in the BAG
The MART's new HELD ITEMS counter sells the SITRUS BERRY, LEFTOVERS and FOCUS SASH from 2 badges, and the LIFE ORB and CHOICE SCARF from 4
The CHOICE SCARF now really raises SPEED by half, for trainers' POKéMON too. A FOCUS SASH or SITRUS BERRY is used up once it works
EGGS in your party have an EGG picture
The BATTLE MOVES page no longer runs a move's type into its PP
Version numbers now have three parts: new regions, new features, then fixes

changelog.title: Eggs in the party
changes: The EGGS you carry show in the party screen's free slots, with a bar that fills as each one nears hatching and the steps it has left. With a full party, the message says when the next one hatches
Using a REPEL while one is still working no longer uses it up

changelog.title: Stones, TMs and the Day Care
changes: Evolution stones (FIRE, WATER, THUNDER, LEAF, MOON, SUN, SHINY, DUSK, DAWN and ICE), sold at the MART's new EVOLUTION counter once you have 3 badges. EEVEE, CLAMPERL and the others that never evolved now can

Trade evolutions use the LINKING CORD, from the same counter, alongside the OVAL STONE, RAZOR CLAW and RAZOR FANG. POKéMON whose evolution needed something this game doesn't have now evolve at a level
TMs: the MART's TMs counter sells 73 of them, with stronger moves unlocking as you earn badges. A TM never runs out
The MOVE TUTOR in every POKéMON CENTER teaches back any move your POKéMON could have learned by its level
REPEL, SUPER REPEL, MAX REPEL and the ESCAPE ROPE, in every MART
The GOOD ROD (3 badges) and SUPER ROD (6 badges), from the FISHERMAN who gave you the OLD ROD: fewer misses, higher levels and rarer catches
Trainer rematches: route trainers will battle again once a day (every 30 minutes of play), with their full team at your level
The DAY CARE in CINDERGATE TOWN raises up to two POKéMON as you walk. Two that get along may leave an EGG, which hatches into a level 1 POKéMON
The MAX POTION, in the MART from 6 badges
Using an item that only works outside battle now says so instead of doing nothing

changelog.title: Crash Fixes
changes: Fixed a crash when walking from an area with weather (rain, fog, snow or a cave) into a bigger town, such as ROUTE 3 into TIDALKEEP CITY or ROUTE 5 into WISPGATE CITY

Fixed a crash when opening a PC box holding many different POKéMON. Icons in the PC and the party now share their colours, so a shiny's icon shows its normal colours (it's still shiny in battle and on its summary)

changelog.title: The Master Ball
changes: The MASTER BALL: the best ball there is. It catches any wild POKéMON without fail
At the Sunken Shrine, WREN now hands you a MASTER BALL before you face the guardian

changelog.title: Trades, the Safari Zone and Hidden Items
changes: TRADEWIND VILLAGE: south of WISPGATE CITY, open once you beat its Gym Leader. Its TRADER swaps one of your POKéMON for a random one of about the same level
The SAFARI ZONE, north of PORTMERE HARBOUR: $5000 to enter, and every POKéMON, legendaries included, is as likely to appear as any other
Hidden items: watch for a glint on the ground, then face the spot and press A. RARE CANDIES and better POKé BALLS are waiting along the way
New items: GREAT BALL (1.5x catch rate) and ULTRA BALL (2x) in the POKé MART from your 2nd and 5th badges, and the RARE CANDY, which raises a POKéMON by one level

changelog.title: Fast Travel and Faster Days
changes: Open the POKéNAV map and pick any town or route you've been to, then press A to travel there
Towns drop you at the POKéMON CENTER door; routes put you on the path where you'd enter them
Days go by faster: morning, day, evening and night now last 7.5 minutes of play each, so a full day is 30 minutes

changelog.title: PP, Stat Moves and Weather
changes: Every move has PP. A POKéMON CENTER refills it; a Pokémon with no PP left will Struggle
New moves to learn: stat boosters like SWORDS DANCE and CALM MIND, stat drops like GROWL and LEER, healing like RECOVER, and SUNNY DAY, RAIN DANCE, SANDSTORM and HAIL
ABSORB and GIGA DRAIN heal the user, DOUBLE-EDGE has recoil, and EARTHQUAKE or ROCK SLIDE hit every foe
FIGHT now asks for a target first. Moves are coloured for it: red super effective, yellow a normal hit, grey no effect. B goes back to change the target

changelog.title: Shiny Pokémon and Spirecrest Town
changes: Shiny Pokémon: 1 in 4096, twice as often in ADVENTURE MODE and 1.25 times in a NUZLOCKE run. They sparkle when they appear
The CHALLENGE TOWER now stands in its own town, SPIRECREST, south of DUSKMERE HOLLOW. It opens once you're CHAMPION
Five themed floors, a SUMMONING STONE at the top, and a chamber themed for the legendary it calls

changelog.title: Nuzlocke and Adventure Mode
changes: NUZLOCKE mode at NEW GAME: fainted Pokémon are gone, one catch per area, level caps, and a GRAVEYARD in the PC
SKIP STORY TEXT for faster replays
After the credits, ADVENTURE MODE and the CHALLENGE TOWER, with legendaries to catch at the top

changelog.title: Party Royale on the Game Boy Advance
changes: The whole adventure, from the professor's welcome to the Hall of Fame
Every move animated in battle, and catching with each Pokémon's real catch rate
